steps.title: Hook and magnet
steps.body: Things that pull and hold, as in Zelda: a hook line (the hookshot), a grapple rope to hang and swing from, and a magnet glove (Breath of the Wild’s Magnesis). They are under Starter pack › Hook and magnet. Each one works by the physics: on a line the lighter end moves, a hanging hero is a pendulum, and the glove holds a thing up with a spring.
steps.task: Open Starter pack in the bottom dock.

steps.title: A wall with a hook target
steps.body: Place the Hook line beside the start, a Smooth wall 16 studs ahead (too smooth to climb), and a Hook target on top of the wall. The hook catches on hook targets and on wood; on stone it clinks and comes back.
steps.task: Place the Hook line, a Smooth wall and a Hook target on it.

steps.title: Up the wall
steps.body: Press Play and walk over the hook line; press its button (J). Face the target and hold F: the hero stands and aims, dots show the line, and the mark turns green on something it will catch. Let go: the chain shoots out, the hook catches, and you are pulled up along it (the chain holds your weight), then climb onto the top of the wall.
steps.task: Press Play and hook yourself up the wall.

steps.title: Pull a light crate to you
steps.body: Stop the game. Place a Light crate to the left of the start, about 8 studs ahead. Press Play, take out the hook line and shoot it at the crate: it is lighter than you (3.8 against your 6), so it comes to you instead of you going to it.
steps.task: Place a Light crate, press Play and hook it to you.

steps.title: A beam to swing from
steps.body: Stop the game. Place the Grapple rope beside the start and a Swing beam to the right, about 8 studs ahead.
steps.task: Place the Grapple rope and a Swing beam.

steps.title: Swing
steps.body: Press Play, walk over the grapple rope and press its button. Stand under the beam, hold F to aim up at it and let go: the claw catches the beam and you hang from the rope. Hold Shift and W to climb up off the ground, then W and S to swing (push as the swing goes, as on a playground swing). Press Space to let go: you fly on with the swing’s speed.
steps.task: Press Play, hang from the beam, swing and let go.

steps.title: Metal and a switch
steps.body: Stop the game. Place the Magnet glove beside the start, an Iron crate 6 studs ahead to the left, and a Floor switch 6 studs further left.
steps.task: Place the Magnet glove, an Iron crate and a Floor switch.

steps.title: Lift it onto the switch
steps.body: Press Play, walk over the magnet glove and press its button. Face the iron crate and hold F: it rises and floats in front of you (W and S move it out and in, A and D turn). Walk until it hangs over the floor switch and let go of F: it drops and holds the switch down. Only metal answers the glove, and iron is heavy: the hook line will not pull it.
steps.task: Press Play and drop the iron crate on the switch.

steps.title: Done!
steps.body: You hooked yourself up a wall, pulled a light crate to you, swung on a rope and let go, and carried an iron crate with the magnet glove. Make your own: in the Asset studio’s Wind and lifting section, tick The hook catches on it (a ring, a beam) or Metal (the glove lifts a loose one).
